w.name: SLA | A contract in one department can use a support plan (and its SLA) from another department
w.description_html:
Summary

Support plans and SLA policies belong to a department, and a contract belongs to a department. Desk accepts a contract in one department with a support plan from another department, so the other department’s SLA is applied to this customer. In Zoho Desk a contract is created inside its department and the Support Plan field only lists that department’s plans.

Steps to Reproduce

  1. In Setup › Support Plans, select department B and create a support plan with an SLA policy of department B.

  2. Create a contract in department A (with an account, start and end date) and choose the department B plan as its support plan.

  3. Open the contract.

  4. Go to Setup › Support Plans and select department B.

Expected Result

  • Only department A’s support plans can be chosen for a department A contract; a plan from another department is refused.

Actual Result

  • The contract is saved. Its Department is QA AO Dept A, and Support Plan Info shows the QA AO Dept B plan and its Dept B SLA.

  • Support Plans for QA AO Dept B lists that plan with Contracts = 1.

  • Attaching a Dept B plan to an existing Dept A contract was also accepted on 9 Nov.

  • Note: the contract was created through the API; whether the New Contract form also offers other departments’ plans was not checked.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), Microsoft Edge, Windows 10, owner account, 10 Nov 2026 12:10 UTC. Zoho Desk (techsolutionsegypt) checked live, read-only: Add Contract under the current department; plans loaded with departmentId of the current department.

Attachment

Annotated comparison with Zoho attached (SL-60-contract-takes-plan-from-another-department-vs-zoho.png).

L.comment_stripped:
Fix is in review: desk PR #259 and client-engine PR #840. Not deployed yet.
Reproduced on staging 16 Nov: I attached a QA AO Dept B plan to a QA AO Dept A contract, and it was accepted. I put the contract's original plan back and removed the test plan.
Change: a contract now takes only a plan from its own department. The contract's plan picker lists only that department's plans. Attaching another department's plan is refused with a clear message. A contract saved through the API with another department's plan doesn't get it.
Not covered yet:
The New Contract form's plan field still lists every department's plans. The plan is not applied, but the field keeps the value.
A contract moved to another department keeps its old plan.
A contract with no department accepts any plan.
To retest after deploy: use clause 8, attaching a Dept B plan from the contract's Support Plan panel.

L.comment_stripped:
Thanks for the retest. Both failing items are fixed and in review: metadata-engine PR #234 and client-engine PR #848 (desk PR #264 is docs only). Not deployed yet.
Saving a contract with another department's plan is now refused with 422 SUPPORT_PLAN_OTHER_DEPARTMENT on the Support Plan field: "this support plan belongs to another department. Choose a plan of the contract's own department." Nothing is created. The contract's department is the one the save sets, or else the one it already has. So moving a contract to Dept B together with a Dept B plan still works.
The New Contract form's plan field now lists only the plans of the contract's own Department. Before a Department is chosen, it uses the account's department, as before. If the Department is changed after a plan was picked, the field shows an error until a matching plan is chosen. English and Arabic.
Still not covered: a contract with no department accepts any plan, as before. Changing only the Department of a contract that already has a plan is not refused.
To retest after deploy: the two "Still failing" steps from your retest.
